mechanism: Budesonide, a corticosteroid, can cause hypokalemia through increased renal potassium excretion and reduced intestinal potassium absorption, necessitating potassium supplementation monitoring.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly during budesonide therapy; ensure adequate potassium intake or supplementation if hypokalemia develops; consider potassium-sparing agents if chronic corticosteroid use is required.
